subject.title: feat(clients): session groups, batch actions, inspector, and worktree-aware creation for native chat

question: After the refresh-limit repair and real native-chat proof, should the repository accept this broad shared OpenClawKit session-management parity surface for macOS and future iOS adoption?
rationale: The PR introduces a substantial user-facing native-client capability and changes shared transport behavior; prior parity work is positive context, but the intended long-term product and API scope still requires maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Sponsor the parity surface after repair
options.body: Accept the groups, batch actions, inspector, and worktree-selection direction once the roster regression, caller compatibility review, and real behavior proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Land only the session-management portions that maintainers want in the shared kit and defer the broader worktree-selection UI to a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Keep the branch open without merge until native-client product scope and shared transport ownership are explicitly settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the parity surface after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the groups, batch actions, inspector, and worktree-selection direction once the roster regression, caller compatibility review, and real behavior proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged parity work and this proposal place the shared native-chat feature history with this contributor.
